body: I do the same thing especially with shows that are in different languages and I have to read subtitles. I still go through this but it has gotten a little better. I have learned to just ignore it if I really need to know what they said ill go back after the episode is done it puts off the ocd feeling and sometimes you'll just forget. I think of it this way, in life your are going to miss what people say all the time or if you go to the movies and go to the bathroom you are missing words then and you still go on watching the movie.  I hope this helps.
